title: KOMAN: emergency descent under an active TSA
objective: Clear traffic out of an activating TSA, then handle an emergency descent through busy levels without losing separation.
challenges: TSA activates FL195+ with traffic inside or close to it
Unplanned traffic and a level bust late in the session
criteria: No aircraft inside the TSA at FL195+ once it is active
Emergency acknowledged within 30 s and kept clear of other traffic down to FL100
No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Emergencies and STCA handled before routine requests

injects.text: Military activity: a TSA becomes active in five minutes, FL195 and above.
injects.objective: No aircraft inside the active area at FL195+ (10 min after activation)

injects.text: A flight under the TSA asks for its cruising level.
Pressurisation failure. Emergency descent to FL100, squawk 7700, diverting.
injects.objective: Acknowledged within 30 s, and no STCA with it in the descent to FL100
No STCA involving it in its first 3 min

injects.text: An aircraft passes its cleared level.
